events.title: Output collapse: GDP per capita fell 16%
events.detail: Real GDP per capita fell from 443 to 373 (constant 2015 US$) in a single year.
events.source: derived: World Bank GDP per capita
events.contested: A one-year collapse of this size usually has several causes at once - war, currency crisis, commodity price, or the end of a political order. This marker says it happened; it does not say why.

events.title: Democratic opening: electoral democracy index rose 0.24 over 5 years
events.detail: From 0.14 in 1969 to 0.38 in 1974. Derived by detecting a sustained shift of at least 0.2 index points over 5 years; marked at the steepest year of the episode.
events.contested: V-Dem indices are aggregated expert judgements with published uncertainty intervals. A shift of this size is well outside the noise, but the exact year is a property of the detection rule, not a documented event.

events.title: Grameen Bank established as a specialised institution
events.detail: Group-liability microcredit lending to the rural poor, largely to women, was given a formal legal charter after several years as a pilot project.
events.contested: Once presented as a general solution to poverty, later randomised evaluations found modest effects on consumption and business investment and little effect on income or schooling. Whether the model's main contribution was credit or women's participation in a formal institution is still argued.
events.refs: ["Grameen Bank Ordinance 1983 (Bangladesh)", "Banerjee, Karlan & Zinman, 'Six Randomized Evaluations of Microcredit' (2015)"]
